name: spt-load-test
title: SPT Load Test
author: versuffer
description: Headless load-test driver for the space-power-transmitter: a 500 GW primary-output source on one isolated network feeds a 400 GW primary-input load on another isolated network through the transmitter link. Enabled only by tests/loadtest.sh in a temporary mod directory; never ship or enable it in a real game.
